tags.name: Issuer Identification Number (IIN)
tags.description: The number that identifies the major industry and the card issuer and that forms the first part of the Primary Account Number (PAN)

tags.name: Application Dedicated File (ADF) Name
tags.description: Identifies the application as described in ISO/IEC 7816-5

tags.name: Application Label
tags.description: Mnemonic associated with the AID according to ISO/IEC 7816-5

tags.name: Track 2 Equivalent Data
tags.description: Contains the data elements of track 2 according to ISO/IEC 7813, excluding start sentinel, end sentinel, and Longitudinal Redundancy Check (LRC), as follows: Primary Account Number (n, var. up to 19) + Field Separator (Hex 'D') + Expiration Date (YYMM, n 4) + Service Code (n 3) + Discretionary Data (n, var.) + Pad with one Hex 'F' if needed to ensure whole bytes

tags.name: Application Primary Account Number (PAN)
tags.description: Valid cardholder account number

tags.name: Cardholder Name
tags.description: Indicates cardholder name according to ISO/IEC 7813

tags.name: Application Expiration Date
tags.description: Date after which application expires

tags.name: Application Effective Date
tags.description: Date from which the application may be used

tags.name: Issuer Country Code (numeric)
tags.description: Indicates the country of the issuer according to ISO 3166

tags.name: Transaction Currency Code
tags.description: Indicates the currency code of the transaction according to ISO 4217

tags.name: Language Preference
tags.description: 1-4 languages stored in order of preference, each represented by 2 alphabetical characters according to ISO 639. Note: EMVCo strongly recommends that cards be personalised with data element '5F2D' coded in lowercase, but that terminals accept the data element whether it is coded in upper or lower case.
tags.note: Recommended to store in lowercase, but terminals should accept both cases

tags.name: Service Code
tags.description: Service code as defined in ISO/IEC 7813 for track 1 and track 2

tags.name: Application Primary Account Number (PAN) Sequence Number
tags.description: Identifies and differentiates cards with the same PAN

tags.name: Transaction Currency Exponent
tags.description: Indicates the implied position of the decimal point from the right of the transaction amount represented according to ISO 4217

tags.name: Issuer URL
tags.description: The URL provides the location of the Issuer's Library Server on the Internet.

tags.name: International Bank Account Number (IBAN)
tags.description: Uniquely identifies the account of a customer at a financial institution as defined in ISO 13616

tags.name: Bank Identifier Code (BIC)
tags.description: Uniquely identifies a bank as defined in ISO 9362

tags.name: Issuer Country Code (alpha2 format)
tags.description: Indicates the country of the issuer as defined in ISO 3166 (using a 2 character alphabetic code)

tags.name: Issuer Country Code (alpha3 format)
tags.description: Indicates the country of the issuer as defined in ISO 3166 (using a 3 character alphabetic code)

tags.name: Account Type
tags.description: Indicates the type of account selected on the terminal, coded as specified in Annex G

tags.name: Application Template
tags.description: Contains one or more data objects relevant to an application directory entry according to ISO/IEC 7816-5

tags.name: File Control Information (FCI) Template
tags.description: Identifies the FCI template according to ISO/IEC 7816-4

tags.name: READ RECORD Response Message Template
tags.description: Contains the contents of the record read. (Mandatory for SFIs 1-10. Response messages for SFIs 11-30 are outside the scope of EMV, but may use template '70')
tags.note: For SFIs 1-10 (EMV scope), for SFIs 11-30 (outside EMV scope but may use this template)

tags.name: Issuer Script Template 1
tags.description: Contains proprietary issuer data for transmission to the ICC before the second GENERATE AC command

tags.name: Issuer Script Template 2
tags.description: Contains proprietary issuer data for transmission to the ICC after the second GENERATE AC command

tags.name: Directory Discretionary Template
tags.description: Issuer discretionary part of the directory according to ISO/IEC 7816-5

tags.name: Response Message Template Format 2
tags.description: Contains the data objects (with tags and lengths) returned by the ICC in response to a command

variants.name: Biometric Information Template (BIT) - Card
variants.description: A template defined in ISO/IEC 19785-3, that describes information regarding the biometric format and solution supported in a card

variants.name: Biometric Information Template (BIT) - Terminal
variants.description: A template defined in ISO/IEC 19785-3, that describes information regarding the biometric format and solution supported in a terminal

tags.name: Response Message Template Format 1
tags.description: Contains the data objects (without tags and lengths) returned by the ICC in response to a command

variants.name: Amount, Authorised (Binary)
variants.description: Authorised amount of the transaction (excluding adjustments)

variants.name: Biometric Type
variants.description: A data element defined in ISO/IEC 19785-3, that describes the type of biometrics supported by the card or terminal among facial, finger, iris, palm and voice, as shown in Table 49.

variants.name: Application Interchange Profile
variants.description: Indicates the capabilities of the card to support specific functions in the application

enumMap.1: Terminal risk management is to be performed

enumMap.0: On device cardholder verification not supported
enumMap.1: On device cardholder verification is supported

variants.name: Biometric Subtype
variants.description: A data element defined in ISO/IEC 19785-3, that describes the subtype of the Biometric Type supported by the card or terminal, as shown in Table 50.

tags.name: Command Template
tags.description: Identifies the data field of a command message

tags.name: Dedicated File (DF) Name
tags.description: Identifies the name of the DF as described in ISO/IEC 7816-4

tags.name: Issuer Script Command
tags.description: Contains a command for transmission to the ICC

tags.name: Application Priority Indicator
tags.description: Indicates the priority of a given application or group of applications in a directory

tags.name: Short File Identifier (SFI)
tags.description: Identifies the AEF referenced in commands related to a given ADF or DDF. It is a binary data object having a value in the range 1 to 30 and with the three high order bits set to zero.
tags.note: Three high order bits must be zero (binary: 000xxxxx)

tags.name: Authorisation Code
tags.description: Value generated by the authorisation authority for an approved transaction

tags.name: Authorisation Response Code
tags.description: Code that defines the disposition of a message

tags.name: Card Risk Management Data Object List 1 (CDOL1)
tags.description: List of data objects (tag and length) to be passed to the ICC in the first GENERATE AC command

tags.name: Card Risk Management Data Object List 2 (CDOL2)
tags.description: List of data objects (tag and length) to be passed to the ICC in the second GENERATE AC command

tags.name: Cardholder Verification Method (CVM) List
tags.description: Identifies a method of verification of the cardholder supported by the application

tags.name: Certification Authority Public Key Index (ICC)
tags.description: Identifies the certification authority's public key in conjunction with the RID

variants.name: Biometric Solution ID
variants.description: A unique identifier assigned by EMVCo that is used to identify a biometric program, regional or global, supported by the card or terminal. The Biometric Solution ID is referred to within ISO/IEC 19785-3 as the 'Index'.

variants.name: Issuer Public Key Certificate
variants.description: Issuer public key certified by a certification authority. Format and length are different depending on RSA or ECC.

tags.name: Issuer Authentication Data
tags.description: Data sent to the ICC for online issuer authentication

tags.name: Issuer Public Key Remainder
tags.description: Remaining digits of the Issuer Public Key Modulus
tags.length_note: NI: Issuer public key modulus length, NCA: certification authority public key length

tags.name: Signed Static Application Data
tags.description: Digital signature on critical application parameters for SDA

tags.name: Application File Locator (AFL)
tags.description: Indicates the location (SFI, range of records) of the AEFs related to a given application

tags.name: Terminal Verification Results

tags.name: Transaction Certificate Data Object List (TDOL)
tags.description: List of data objects (tag and length) to be used by the terminal in generating the TC Hash Value
tags.note: Defines data to be included in TC Hash Value calculation

tags.name: Transaction Certificate (TC) Hash Value
tags.description: Result of a hash function specified in Book 2, section B3.1

tags.name: Transaction Personal Identification Number (PIN) Data
tags.description: Data entered by the cardholder for the purpose of the PIN verification

tags.name: Transaction Date
tags.description: Local date that the transaction was authorised

tags.name: Transaction Status Information
tags.description: Indicates the functions performed in a transaction

tags.name: Transaction Type
tags.description: Indicates the type of financial transaction, represented by the first two digits of the ISO 8583:1987 Processing Code. The actual values to be used for the Transaction Type data element are defined by the relevant payment system

tags.name: Directory Definition File (DDF) Name
tags.description: Identifies the name of a DF associated with a directory

tags.name: Acquirer Identifier
tags.description: Uniquely identifies the acquirer within each payment system

tags.name: Amount, Authorised (Numeric)
tags.description: Authorised amount of the transaction (excluding adjustments)

tags.name: Amount, Other (Numeric)
tags.description: Secondary amount associated with the transaction representing a cashback amount

tags.name: Amount, Other (Binary)
tags.description: Secondary amount associated with the transaction representing a cashback amount

tags.name: Application Discretionary Data
tags.description: Issuer or payment system specified data relating to the application

tags.name: Application Identifier (AID) – terminal
tags.description: Identifies the application as described in ISO/IEC 7816-5

tags.name: Application Usage Control
tags.description: Indicates issuer’s specified restrictions on the geographic usage and services allowed for the application

tags.name: Application Version Number
tags.description: Version number assigned by the payment system for the application

tags.name: Application Version Number
tags.description: Version number assigned by the payment system for the application

tags.name: Application Selection Registered Proprietary Data (ASRPD)
tags.description: Proprietary data allowing for proprietary processing during application selection. Proprietary data is identified using Proprietary Data Identifiers that are managed by EMVCo and their usage by the Application Selection processing is according to their intended usage, as agreed by EMVCo during registration

tags.name: Cardholder Name Extended
tags.description: Indicates the whole cardholder name when greater than 26 characters using the same coding convention as in ISO/IEC 7813

tags.name: Issuer Identification Number Extended (IINE)
tags.description: The number that identifies the major industry and the card issuer and that forms the first part (6 or 8 digits) of the Primary Account Number (PAN). While the first 6 digits of the IINE (tag '9F0C') and IIN (tag '42') are the same and there is no need to have both data objects on the card, cards may have both the IIN and IINE data objects present.

tags.name: Issuer Action Code - Default
tags.description: Specifies the issuer's conditions that cause a transaction to be rejected if it might have been approved online, but the terminal is unable to process the transaction online

tags.name: Issuer Action Code - Denial
tags.description: Specifies the issuer's conditions that cause the denial of a transaction without attempt to go online

tags.name: Issuer Action Code - Online
tags.description: Specifies the issuer's conditions that cause a transaction to be transmitted online

tags.name: Issuer Application Data
tags.description: Contains proprietary application data for transmission to the issuer in an online transaction. Note: For CCD-compliant applications, Annex C, section C7 defines the specific coding of the Issuer Application Data (IAD). To avoid potential conflicts with CCD-compliant applications, it is strongly recommended that the IAD data element in an application that is not CCD-compliant should not use the coding for a CCD-compliant application

tags.name: Issuer Code Table Index
tags.description: Indicates the code table according to ISO/IEC 8859 for displaying the Application Preferred Name

tags.name: Application Preferred Name
tags.description: Preferred mnemonic associated with the AID

tags.name: Last Online Application Transaction Counter (ATC) Register
tags.description: ATC value of the last transaction that went online

tags.name: Lower Consecutive Offline Limit
tags.description: Issuer-specified preference for the maximum number of consecutive offline transactions for this ICC application allowed in a terminal with online capability

tags.name: Merchant Category Code
tags.description: Classifies the type of business being done by the merchant, represented according to ISO 8583:1993 for Card Acceptor Business Code

tags.name: Merchant Identifier
tags.description: When concatenated with the Acquirer Identifier, uniquely identifies a given merchant

tags.name: Personal Identification Number (PIN) Try Counter
tags.description: Number of PIN tries remaining

tags.name: Issuer Script Identifier
tags.description: Identification of the Issuer Script

tags.name: Token Requestor ID
tags.description: Uniquely identifies the pairing of the Token Requestor with the Token Domain, as defined in the EMV Payment Tokenisation Framework

tags.name: Terminal Country Code
tags.description: Indicates the country of the terminal, represented according to ISO 3166

tags.name: Terminal Floor Limit
tags.description: Indicates the floor limit in the terminal in conjunction with the AID

tags.name: Terminal Identification
tags.description: Designates the unique location of a terminal at a merchant

tags.name: Terminal Risk Management Data
tags.description: Application-specific value used by the card for risk management purposes

tags.name: Interface Device (IFD) Serial Number
tags.description: Unique and permanent serial number assigned to the IFD by the manufacturer

tags.name: Track 1 Discretionary Data
tags.description: Discretionary part of track 1 according to ISO/IEC 7813

tags.name: Track 2 Discretionary Data
tags.description: Discretionary part of track 2 according to ISO/IEC 7813

tags.name: Transaction Time
tags.description: Local time that the transaction was authorised

tags.name: Certification Authority Public Key Index (Terminal)
tags.description: Identifies the certification authority's public key in conjunction with the RID

tags.name: Upper Consecutive Offline Limit
tags.description: Issuer-specified preference for the maximum number of consecutive offline transactions for this ICC application allowed in a terminal without online capability

tags.name: Payment Account Reference (PAR)
tags.description: A non-financial reference assigned to each unique PAN and used to link a Payment Account represented by that PAN to affiliated Payment Tokens, as defined in the EMV Tokenisation Framework. The PAR may be assigned in advance of Payment Token issuance.

tags.name: Last 4 Digits of PAN
tags.description: The last four digits of the PAN, as defined in the EMV Payment Tokenisation Framework

tags.name: Application Cryptogram
tags.description: Cryptogram returned by the ICC in response of the GENERATE AC command

tags.name: Cryptogram Information Data
tags.description: Indicates the type of cryptogram and the actions to be performed by the terminal

tags.name: Integrated Circuit Card (ICC) PIN Encipherment Public Key Certificate (RSA) or Integrated Circuit Card (ICC) Public Key Certificate for ODE (ECC)
tags.description: ICC Public Key certified by the issuer for PIN or biometric encipherment (ODE). Format and length are different depending on RSA or ECC.

tags.name: Integrated Circuit Card (ICC) PIN Encipherment Public Key Exponent
tags.description: ICC PIN Encipherment Public Key Exponent used for PIN encipherment

tags.description: Remaining digits of the ICC PIN Encipherment Public Key Modulus
tags.length_note: NPE: PIN encipherment public key modulus length, NI: certificate length

tags.name: Biometric Terminal Capabilities
tags.description: A data element that identifies the Biometric CVM capabilities of the terminal

tags.name: Card BIT Group Template
tags.description: A template in the card that contains one or more Biometric Information Templates (BITs)

tags.name: Issuer Public Key Exponent
tags.description: Issuer public key exponent used for the verification of the Signed Static Application Data and the ICC Public Key Certificate

tags.name: Terminal Capabilities
tags.description: Indicates the card data input, CVM, and security capabilities of the terminal for the selected AID

tags.name: Cardholder Verification Method (CVM) Results
tags.description: Indicates the results of the last CVM performed

tags.name: Terminal Type
tags.description: Indicates the environment of the terminal, its communications capability, and its operational control

tags.name: Application Transaction Counter (ATC)
tags.description: Counter maintained by the application in the ICC (incrementing the ATC is managed by the ICC)

tags.name: Unpredictable Number
tags.description: Value to provide variability and uniqueness to the generation of a cryptogram

tags.name: Processing Options Data Object List (PDOL)
tags.description: Contains a list of terminal resident data objects (tags and lengths) needed by the ICC in processing the GET PROCESSING OPTIONS command
tags.note: Defines data required by card for GET PROCESSING OPTIONS

tags.name: Point-of-Service (POS) Entry Mode
tags.description: Indicates the method by which the PAN was entered, according to the first two digits of the ISO 8583:1987 POS Entry Mode

enumMap.91: Magnetic stripe read, terminal with ICC capability
enumMap.95: ICC read, terminal with ICC capability

tags.name: Amount, Reference Currency
tags.description: Authorised amount expressed in the reference currency

tags.name: Application Reference Currency
tags.description: 1-4 currency codes used between the terminal and the ICC when the Transaction Currency Code is different from the Application Currency Code; each code is 3 digits according to ISO 4217

tags.name: Transaction Reference Currency Code
tags.description: Code defining the common currency used by the terminal in case the Transaction Currency Code is different from the Application Currency Code

tags.name: Transaction Reference Currency Exponent
tags.description: Indicates the implied position of the decimal point from the right of the transaction amount, with the Transaction Reference Currency Code represented according to ISO 4217

tags.name: Additional Terminal Capabilities
tags.description: Indicates the data input and output capabilities of the terminal

tags.name: Transaction Sequence Counter
tags.description: Counter maintained by the terminal that is incremented by one for each transaction

tags.name: Application Currency Code
tags.description: Indicates the currency in which the account is managed according to ISO 4217

tags.name: Application Reference Currency Exponent
tags.description: Indicates the implied position of the decimal point from the right of the amount, for each of the 1-4 reference currencies represented according to ISO 4217

tags.name: Application Currency Exponent
tags.description: Indicates the implied position of the decimal point from the right of the amount represented according to ISO 4217

tags.name: Data Authentication Code
tags.description: An issuer assigned value that is retained by the terminal during the verification process of the Signed Static Application Data

tags.name: Integrated Circuit Card (ICC) Public Key Certificate
tags.description: ICC Public Key certified by the issuer. Format and length are different depending on RSA or ECC.

tags.name: Integrated Circuit Card (ICC) Public Key Exponent
tags.description: ICC Public Key Exponent used for the verification of the Signed Dynamic Application Data

tags.name: Integrated Circuit Card (ICC) Public Key Remainder
tags.description: Remaining digits of the ICC Public Key Modulus
tags.length_note: NIC: ICC public key modulus length, NI: certificate length

tags.name: Dynamic Data Authentication Data Object List (DDOL)
tags.description: List of data objects (tag and length) to be passed to the ICC in the INTERNAL AUTHENTICATE command

tags.name: Static Data Authentication Tag List
tags.description: List of tags of primitive data objects defined in this specification whose value fields are to be included in the Signed Static or Dynamic Application Data
tags.note: List of tags to be included in SDA/DDA signature calculation

tags.name: Signed Dynamic Application Data
tags.description: Digital signature on critical application parameters for DDA or CDA

tags.name: ICC Dynamic Number
tags.description: Time-variant number generated by the ICC, to be captured by the terminal

tags.name: Log Entry
tags.description: Provides the SFI of the Transaction Log file and its number of records

tags.name: Merchant Name and Location
tags.description: Indicates the name and location of the merchant

tags.name: Log Format
tags.description: List (in tag and length format) of data objects representing the logged data elements that are passed to the terminal when a transaction log record is read
tags.note: Defines the structure of transaction log records

tags.name: Biometric Header Template (BHT)
tags.description: A template defined in ISO/IEC 19785-3, that is nested under the BIT

tags.name: File Control Information (FCI) Proprietary Template
tags.description: Identifies the data object proprietary to this specification in the FCI template according to ISO/IEC 7816-4

tags.name: File Control Information (FCI) Issuer Discretionary Data
tags.description: Issuer discretionary part of the FCI

tags.name: Offline BIT Group Template
tags.description: A template, defined in ISO/IEC 7816-11, that is nested under the Card BIT Group Template, as shown in Table 51, and contains one or more multiple Biometric Information Templates (BITs) for offline biometric verification supported by card

tags.name: Online BIT Group Template
tags.description: A template, defined in ISO/IEC 7816-11, that is nested under the Card BIT Group Template, as shown in Table 51, and contains one or more multiple Biometric Information Templates (BITs) for online biometric verification supported by card

tags.name: Biometric Try Counters Template
tags.description: A template that contains one or more of the following Biometric Try Counters: • Facial Try Counter • Finger Try Counter • Iris Try Counter • Palm Try Counter • Voice Try Counter

tags.name: Preferred Attempts Template
tags.description: A template that contains the TLV-coded values for the preferred attempts of any BIT of a Biometric Type. It contains one or more of the following: • Preferred Facial Attempts • Preferred Finger Attempts • Preferred Iris Attempts • Preferred Palm Attempts • Preferred Voice Attempts

tags.name: Biometric Verification Data Template
tags.description: A template that contains the TLV-coded values for the data to be included in the VERIFY command. The Biometric Verification Data Template contains Biometric Type ('81'), Biometric Solution ID ('90'), Enciphered Biometric Key Seed ('DF50'), Enciphered Biometric Data (tag 'DF51'), and MAC of Enciphered Biometric Data (tag 'DF52').

variants.name: Enciphered Biometric Key Seed
variants.description: The Biometric Key Seed enciphered using the public key from the ICC

variants.name: Facial Try Counter
variants.description: Identifies the number of facial verification tries remaining

variants.name: Preferred Facial Attempts
variants.description: Number of preferred attempts for any BIT of the facial Biometric Type stored in the card.

variants.name: Enciphered Biometric Data
variants.description: The enciphered data sent in the VERIFY command

variants.name: Finger Try Counter
variants.description: Identifies the number of finger verification tries remaining

variants.name: Preferred Finger Attempts
variants.description: Number of preferred attempts for any BIT of the finger Biometric Type stored in the card.

variants.name: Iris Try Counter
variants.description: Identifies the number of iris verification tries remaining

variants.name: MAC of Enciphered Biometric Data

variants.name: Preferred Iris Attempts
variants.description: Number of preferred attempts for any BIT of the iris Biometric Type stored in the card

variants.name: Palm Try Counter
variants.description: Identifies the number of palm verification tries remaining

variants.name: Preferred Palm Attempts
variants.description: Number of preferred attempts for any BIT of the palm Biometric Type stored in the card.

variants.name: Preferred Voice Attempts
variants.description: Number of preferred attempts for any BIT of the voice Biometric Type stored in the card.

variants.name: Voice Try Counter
variants.description: Identifies the number of voice verification tries remaining

named_tags.name: ARPC
named_tags.description: Cryptogram generated by the issuer and used by the card to verify that the response came from the issuer

named_tags.name: BEK
named_tags.description: An AES-128 key generated from the Biometric Key Seed, that is used to encrypt/decrypt the BDB constructed on the Biometric Processing Application

named_tags.name: Biometric Key Seed
named_tags.description: A random number generated by the terminal, that is used as the seed to generate the Biometric Encryption Key (BEK) and Biometric MAC Key (BMK)

named_tags.name: BMK

named_tags.name: CSU
named_tags.description: Contains data sent to the ICC to indicate whether the issuer approves or declines the transaction, and to initiate actions specified by the issuer. Transmitted to the card in Issuer Authentication Data.

named_tags.description: A check value calculated on the concatenation of all parts of the Certification Authority Public Key (RID, Certification Authority Public Key Index, Certification Authority Public Key Modulus, Certification Authority Public Key Exponent) using SHA-1

named_tags.name: CA_Public_Key_Exponent

named_tags.name: CA_Public_Key_Modulus

named_tags.name: Enciphered_PIN_Data

named_tags.name: Issuer_Script_Results

named_tags.name: Target_Percentage_Random_Selection
